limitations.meaning: The issuer does not represent the record as a basis for payment, financing or other financial reliance.
No third party independently verified every agreed criterion; recorded judgments come from the parties.
The record does not determine legal liability, enforceability or contract consequences.
At least one actor's organization or authority is declared or attested, not independently verified.
The issuer retains file fingerprints, not the delivered originals; availability of originals is not asserted.
Payment, settlement or bank receipt is not verified by this record.
Recorded facts are statements made by the parties, not observations by the issuer.
